title: /api/report-audio-comparison
responsibility: Accepts a same-origin paired audio upload while preserving comparison validation and failure responses.

inputs.name: POST.request
inputs.description: The incoming HTTP Request handled by `POST`. The handler passes it to `admitUploadRequest` with `url.origin` and `101_000_000` before reading multipart data, then requires `before` and `after` to be `File` values.

inputs.name: POST.url
inputs.description: The resolved URL supplied to `POST`. The handler passes its `origin` to `admitUploadRequest` before parsing multipart data and reads no other URL property.

outputs.name: POST
outputs.description: On success, resolves to a 201 JSON `Response` containing the uploaded report and `Cache-Control: no-store`; if admission returns a response, `POST` returns it directly. Caught parse/upload errors become JSON responses with status 409 for messages containing `finaliz`, 404 for `ENOENT`, 400 for `/audio|format|WAV|title|size/i`, and 500 otherwise.

errors.name: Audio comparison requires two files
errors.description: `POST` throws this when either `before` or `after` is not a `File`; its catch handler converts the message (which includes `audio`) into a 400 JSON response.
